label: SYNTHETIC
description: WP-E5 Phase 2/3: 2D transverse detectability sweep over (n_objects, r_s, amplitude), baseline-subtracted per E2.11, two threshold modes, 5 field realizations per cell
extent_provenance: docs/WP_E4_RESOLVABILITY_FLOOR_2026_07_26.md; voxel 6.04 x 6.55 Mpc at nbins=8 => extent = 8 * (6.04, 6.55) = (48.32, 52.40) Mpc
statistic: delta_sigma = sigma(alpha) - sigma(0) against a shared null bank; the null mean cancels identically, so delta_sigma = (beta_1(alpha) - beta_1(0)) / sigma_null
deformation_isotropy: per-axis Gaussian sigma so the warp is isotropic in Mpc, not in voxels
